I love being able to see what I have at a glance while also getting a better feel for what I actually wear & feel comfortable in. Another bonus is that if I am diligent in logging the size and brand of each item, I will eventually be able to see what sizes work best for from certain brand. And let me tell you, I was STOKED when the app updated for the first time in what felt like years (which, to be fair, it definitely was many years before we got an update). 

A few features I wish existed:

- generate outfits specifically from clothes in a packing list
- update the way fabric is entered — rather than enter the fabric content on one line, you should be able to select multiple options. With so many products made with blended materials today, having to enter it differently each time is not very practical. 
- when entering brands or sizes, it should auto filter to op

reviews.body:
终于找到想要的 APP 了，但还是有一些没有达到预期，提一些我的小小建议，希望可以采纳
1.希望真正是一个好的工具，而不是一个为淘宝导流的 APP。毕竟大家的衣服并不都是来自淘宝。
更开发者可以强调它的工具属性，把社区和购买的建议放在后面。不然会像蘑菇街一样黄掉。
